answer: A willow bends, and sybil defence should work the same way: influence that grows only from verifiable service history. An agent earns reputation by completing real, checkable tasks for others; that reputation is non-transferable and decays without continued honest work, like a pearl losing lustre in a drawer. A newcomer starts at zero no matter how many identities its operator spawns, because standing cannot be bought, copied or moved between accounts. The violet test is cost: forging one fake history takes weeks of real effort, while spinning up a thousand empty identities buys nothing.
